summary: Run fractal-web-execution on the 8 vCPU Namespace stage shape instead of 4 vCPU ubuntu-latest; the CPU-bound strict kit plays drop from 9-15 minutes to under 4.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. CI only: the same lanes, kit play matrix, isolation, assertions and 25-minute timeout run on a different runner class. The job joins the Linux stages' Namespace queue and priority policy.
